title: Senior Data Platform Engineer (Infra)
description:
About Us
Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more .
We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day.
About the Role
The Data Applications team builds the data platform that Riskified’s development teams build on. Our goal is to make it self-service: teams get databases, access and data pipelines on Aerospike, CockroachDB, Elasticsearch, Neo4j and PostgreSQL without waiting on us.
We also run the data infrastructure behind Riskified’s AI-driven fraud detection. Our pipelines and low-latency stores feed the models that decide on every order in real time, and connect them to the data lake.
As a Senior Data Platform Engineer, you will own large parts of this platform, from self-service tooling and data pipelines to production clusters of 100+ nodes. You will also be a go-to database expert for R&D.
What You'll Be Doing
• Build self-service tooling and infrastructure as code so development teams can create and manage databases, access and pipelines on their own.
• Build the data infrastructure behind our AI fraud models: pipelines that move data between the data lake and low-latency operational stores, in batch and through change data capture (CDC).
• Design and build new data services, such as low-latency access to data stored on S3.
• Act as the database expert for R&D: review data models and access patterns, and help teams choose the right data store.
• Use AI coding agents in daily work and build automation around them for the team.
• Own large-scale production database clusters (key-value, distributed SQL, search and graph), including performance, cost, and major upgrades and migrations with zero downtime.
• Share an on-call rotation and lead incident investigations across the database, infrastructure and application layers.
Qualifications
• Experienced data platform, database reliability or big data infrastructure engineer, with a B.Sc. in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
• Deep hands-on experience running at least two distributed data stores in production at high scale, such as Aerospike, CockroachDB, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Neo4j, PostgreSQL, Cassandra or Redis.
• Strong grasp of distributed-systems fundamentals: replication, partitioning, consistency models and failure modes.
• Strong coding skills in Python.
• Production experience with Terraform and AWS, including on-call ownership of production incidents.
• Clear communication in English, and a track record of guiding other engineers and teams.
Big plus for this role:
• Lakehouse tools: Spark, Databricks, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg and Airflow.
• Kafka and CDC: CockroachDB changefeeds, Debezium or AWS DMS.
• Aerospike operations: strong consistency, cross-datacenter replication (XDR) and capacity planning.
• Coding in Scala, Java, Go or Node.js/TypeScript, such as client libraries or Terraform providers.
• Kubernetes, and debugging performance at the Linux level (CPU, memory, disk I/O, network).
• Hands-on use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code for infrastructure work.
We discuss salary ranges to support fairness, clarity, and informed decision-making early in the process. Your actual salary will be determined based on your unique skills, experience, and competencies. If your expectations differ, please let us know - we’re always open to a conversation.
The base salary is one part of the total compensation package at Riskified. All full-time regular employees receive a bonus target and are eligible to receive stock-based awards. Also, our value proposition goes way beyond compensation: our perks and benefits package, culture, community, and learning and development programs are just some of the elements we provide to bring value to our employees.
Life at Riskified
We are a fast-growing and dynamic tech company with 750+ team members globally. We value collaboration and innovative thinking.
We’re looking for bright, driven, and passionate people to grow with us.
Some of our Lisbon Benefits & Perks:
• Hybrid mode of work
• Flexible schedule
• Healthcare benefits
• Fully-stocked kitchens
• Benefits package per month—per your choice, e.g., work-from-home equipment, gym membership, wellbeing activities, and more.
• Wellness program
• Celebrations and activities
• Team events
• Happy hours
• Awesome Riskified gifts and swags
• Volunteer programs
• Personal development
• Global onboarding
• Role-based technical skills training
• Full access to Udemy
In the News
C-Tech: We need to find the balance between leveraging innovative AI solutions and using them cautiously
Built In: How We Built This: A Riskified Technologist Unpacks The Company’s Beacon Technology
Globes: Riskified is among Israel’s fastest growing companies
Yahoo: Riskified Earns "Top Rated" Award Across Four TrustRadius Solution Categories
Riskified is deeply committed to the principle of equal opportunity for all individuals. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

title: Senior Software Engineer (TypeScript) - Marketplaces, SSC
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role
Elastic, the Search AI Company, empowers everyone to find answers in real-time, leveraging all their data at scale, and fueling the potential of businesses and individuals. The Elastic Search AI Platform, trusted by over 50% of the Fortune 500, unifies the precision of search with the intelligence of AI to accelerate impactful results.
The Software Engineer will join the self-service cloud marketplaces team, driving the expansion of our marketplaces business through existing partnerships and new integrations. This role directly influences the growth and reach of Elastic Cloud across key marketplace ecosystems.
What You Will Be Doing
• Working as a full stack engineer, contributing both to the backend and frontend of the product onboarding and trial experience.
• Designing and implementing new scalable features and APIs in our product.
• Working closely with PMs and designers to plan and design the features.
• Implementing new integrations and adding new marketplaces.
• Expand the usage and capabilities of the existing marketplaces.
• Designing and implementing data evolution strategies to manage schema changes without introducing breaking changes.
What You Bring
• Strong proficiency in React and JavaScript/TypeScript.
• Strong proficiency in Node.js server frameworks like Hapi and Next.js.
• Front-end tech like HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design is in your wheelhouse.
• You know your way around RESTful APIs and async programming.
• If you've dabbled in state management libraries (like NgRx), that's a big bonus.
• Git and other code collaboration tools don't scare you.
• Experience deploying and operationalizing software in production.
• Ability to plan, design, implement, and lead projects independently.
• Problem-solving is your superpower, and you're all about the details.
• Knowledge in NoSQL databases, such as DynamoDB and Elasticsearch.
• You're an awesome communicator and a great team player.
• Fast-paced environments? No problem for you.
• You're a nerd (in a good way) when it comes to staying on top of industry trends and best practices.
Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.
At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.
The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.
The typical starting salary range for this role is:
€55.800 — €88.300 EUR
Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
• Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
• Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
• Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
• Generous number of vacation days each year
• Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
• Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
• Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave
Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.
We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co . We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.

title: Engineering Manager - CS Tech
description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car , a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton , Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe , we encounter exceptional objects every day.
We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.
Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.
• Taking ownership and driving impact
• Being open to change and feedback
• Being passionate about our mission and our customers.
Your Mission
As an Engineering Manager for CS Tech at Catawiki, you’ll lead and develop a team of 7–10 engineers, shaping the technology at the heart of our customer support experience. Your mission is to delight customers, especially when things don’t go to plan, by building tools that strengthen our AI Frontline and enable the entire Customer Service department to resolve issues quickly, fairly and consistently.
You’ll own the technical direction and partner closely with Product, Design and CS to turn customer insights into better answers, simpler workflows and smooth handovers between AI and people.
By combining technical judgement with empathetic leadership, you’ll help engineers experiment, take ownership and grow while delivering reliable systems. Your influence will extend beyond your team - the decisions you make will shape how AI and people work together to earn customer trust and deliver exceptional support at scale
What You'll Do
You'll help shape Catawiki's post-order journey by leading the team and the technical decisions behind a more reliable shipping experience. Your work will connect customer needs, engineering quality, and the team's growth.
• Lead and grow the team : Build a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.
• Set technical direction : Drive system ownership for the Fulfilment domain, ensuring scalable, maintainable architecture that supports long-term product ambitions.
• Improve the CS experience : Reduce post-order friction and increase reliability for buyers and sellers.
• Shape the roadmap together : Partner with Product and UX to translate business priorities into technical strategy and deliver customer-centric solutions.
• Enable better delivery : Establish engineering standards, improve delivery processes, and introduce measurable quality metrics to help the team deliver faster and with higher quality.
• Balance today and tomorrow : Address immediate delivery needs alongside strategic platform improvements in an evolving scale-up environment.
What You'll Bring
You measure what matters, stay close to the details when needed, and know when to guide versus when to step in. You balance technical leadership with people leadership and care about the team, the systems, and the outcomes they own.
• Software engineering foundation : You bring 5–10 years of software engineering experience.
• People leadership : You have proven experience (3+ years) coaching and developing Engineers, managing performance, and supporting career progression.
• Cross-functional collaboration : You've worked in product teams, partnering effectively with Product, UX, and business stakeholders.
• Technical judgement : You're confident guiding architectural trade-offs and decisions about complex systems.
• End-to-end ownership : You tackle problems through to resolution and move solutions forward through ambiguity.
• Clear communication : You manage stakeholders effectively and influence across teams and seniority levels.
• Relevant domain experience ( nice to have ) : Experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, or scale-ups.
If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we're looking for.
How We Work
You'll be part of our growing Engineering and Product Hub in Portugal, working across locations and disciplines to improve customer service for buyers and sellers.
• You'll work with engineering teams across Amsterdam and Lisbon as part of our growing engineering and product hub in Portugal.
• You'll collaborate with stakeholders across product, design, data, and commercial teams.
• You'll balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in an environment that values clarity, ownership, and measurable impact.
Where You’ll Be
This is a Hybrid role based in Lisbon. You will work from our Lisbon Hub a minimum of 2 days per week.
At this time, we are only considering candidates who are already based in the Portugal . As a result, visa sponsorship and relocation support are not available for this position .
In Return
You'll be part of an enthusiastic, highly motivated team of 800+ Catawikians .
• A competitive Annual Gross Base Salary depending on your level, competencies, and overall experience.
• Meal Allowance Card stipend per working day, in addition to salary.
• Health Insurance from day 1 (including dental coverage), with access to multiple hospitals and clinics and a vast wellness network.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Model Evaluation
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage AI company building agents for manufacturing and supply chain operations. In this research-focused engineering role, you will work with procurement and manufacturing experts to create benchmarks, train models, and improve agents used in real operational workflows.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design benchmarks and evaluation suites for supplier sourcing, qualification, compliance documents, purchase orders, freight, and order tracking.

 - Work with domain experts to scope tasks, write reference answers and rubrics, and build graders.

 - Train and fine-tune models hands-on, using evaluation results to guide experiments.

 - Identify agent failures, develop improvements, and validate those improvements with measured results.

 - Help establish research and evaluation practices as an early member of the team.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of experience, with senior- or staff-level capability.

 - Experience designing and writing benchmarks or evaluations.

 - Experience authoring tasks, including defining scope, creating reference solutions or rubrics, and checking task quality.

 - Hands-on experience training and fine-tuning models, beyond using models through APIs.

 - Ability to work closely with non-ML domain experts and translate their knowledge into measurable tasks.

 - Supply chain, procurement, manufacturing, or early-stage startup experience is a plus.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is $180,000 to $250,000 annually, plus equity. Visa sponsorship policy was not provided.


LOCATION

Fully remote in the United States.

title: AI Transformation Architect [IC4]
description:
Who we are
Our mission is to bring clarity and control to the world's most complex codebases. AI is accelerating code creation, but the infrastructure to understand, oversee, and evolve that code hasn't kept pace. Sourcegraph gives engineering organizations full visibility across their systems, precise context for their agents, and the ability to execute coordinated code changes at scale. As agentic development becomes the dominant engineering paradigm, we provide the context layer teams need to take control of their codebase.
With Code Search, Deep Search, MCP, and Agentic Batch Changes, we deliver on that mission today - giving engineering teams and their AI tools the cross-repo context to navigate massive codebases with confidence, and the ability to make changes across hundreds of repositories at once.
Companies like Stripe, Reddit, and Leidos rely on Sourcegraph to ship faster and with higher quality. We're backed by a16z, Sequoia, and Redpoint, and proud to operate as a globally distributed team that values high agency, direct communication, and customer love.
If you want to build the infrastructure that lets every engineering team - and every agent they deploy - operate on their codebase with confidence, join us.
Working hours
🌎 While we are an all-remote company and hire almost anywhere in the world, we do require successful candidates to be located in the United States.
Preferred location:
• USA
Why this job is exciting
Every engineering organization has bought coding agents. Yet very few can confidently tell you that they’re making the impact they thought they would. They are falling short, not because the model isn’t good enough, but because the codebase is too complex and, outside of a few thousand people employed by OpenAI and Anthropic, nobody understands what good context looks like. Agents can’t access all the code they need, they burn tokens hunting for the right code, and fill the gaps by guessing. Organizations build internal harnesses and knowledge bases using techniques that are outdated before the product is even in use. You’ll be the person to show customers how to actually fix these problems.
Sourcegraph gives the largest, most sophisticated engineering organizations in the world full codebase context so their teams and their agents can understand, oversee, and change their codebase with confidence. As agent adoption grows, and agents write more code, having the right context matters more and more.
Being a brand new role, you’ll be building from scratch. You’ll define what the AI maturity curve looks like inside of enterprise organizations, turn that into a framework customers can use to assess themselves against, and lead engagements with customers where you’ll directly dig into their environment, build an action plan, and work with them to action it. Then you’ll measure again and show what changed and the results they’ve achieved.
You’ll spend your time in customer environments, in the room with VPs of Engineering and staff engineers, and in the product. You’ll also shape the broader market’s view on what good context looks like for agents, which is a question the whole industry is still figuring out. Your results will show up in how customers use the Sourcegraph platform and in the ways they are able to actually make agents work in enterprise codebases.
📅 Within one month, you will…
• Build relationships across Sales, Field Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product
• Learn our products, our value prop, and how our largest customers use Sourcegraph
• Shadow customer calls and interview customers about where their agents succeed and fail today
• Review our existing benchmark studies and draft a first point of view on the dimensions of context that matter most
📅 Within one quarter, you will…
• Publish Sourcegraph’s first perspective on context maturity, grounded in what you’ve learned from customer conversations and our own data
• Ship v1 of the maturity framework: the categories, the criteria that define each stage, and how evidence maps to a score
• Partner with Marketing to launch a self-serve version
• Equip Solutions Engineers to run a lightweight version of the assessment inside of trials
• Run your first assessment with 1-2 select customers, and refine the framework based on what you find
📅 Within six months, you will…
• Be a recognized voice on context and agent readiness, with a steady cadence of writing, talks, or research that engineering leaders reference
• Publish findings from real assessments: what you’re seeing across enterprise codebases, where agents break, and what moves the needle
• Own a repeatable paid engagement with a defined scope, deliverables, and readout
• Deliver action plans that customers execute with you — activating workflows, integrations, and agentic use cases in their own environment
• Re-measure your first customers and show movement up the curve
• Feed what you learn back to EPD as a standing input on agent effectiveness in the enterprise
About you
You’re a consultant at heart, with technical chops and credibility. You can walk into a complex engineering organization, find what’s broken, and leave with a plan people act on. You’re equally comfortable telling a VP of Engineering their environment isn’t where they think it is as you are debating a staff engineer on why.
You build things that didn’t exist before: frameworks, practices, points of view. You can turn insight into action and you’re energized by a blank page as a starting point.
Finally, you’re in the middle of the AI shift yourself. You have deep experience and strong opinions on where agents work and where they don’t, and you share them publicly. You stay on top of AI development, use new models and harnesses as they’re released, and have a perspective on how every generation of these products changes the story.

• 7+ years experience advising enterprise technology or engineering organizations
• Systems or soluti
